title: The adjunction $K\otimes^{\mathrm L}-\dashv\RHom(K,-)$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}$
statement:
Let $X$ and $\Lambda$ be as in [def-sfb-dc-tensor] and [def-sfb-dc-hom]. For
$K\in D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)$, the adjunction

$$
K\otimes^{\mathrm L}-\dashv\RHom(K,-)\qquad\text{on }D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)
$$

is the restriction along the fully faithful inclusion of the ambient tensor–hom adjunction for
$K$.

proof.text:
On $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$, the functor $\RHom_{\Lambda_X}(K,-)$ is right adjoint to
$K\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\Lambda_X}-$ ([sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]). Both functors preserve
bounded constructible complexes, and their restrictions commute with the inclusion
([def-sfb-dc-tensor], [def-sfb-dc-hom]). So the Hom-bijections restrict to $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,\Lambda)$.
